biotools.summary: MPACT (Multimetric Pairwise Comparison Tool) integrates sequence- and structure-based similarity metrics to aid in the demarcation of multiple viral taxonomic levels. The program facilitates viral classification by generating heatmaps and distance trees to visualize viral relationships.
